summary: Tests iteration 92 - Corrections bugs produits: couleur bleue, clickabilité cartes, modal détail, mode édition. Backend: 21/21 OK. Frontend: tous les flows testés et validés.
critical_code_review_comments: CORRECT: Blue color #3B82F6 (rgb(59,130,246)) confirmed on Ajouter button, header icon (BLUE_DIM bg), and price text in my-products.tsx.
CORRECT: Product cards are clickable (testID=product-card-{id}, TouchableOpacity with onPress=setSelected).
CORRECT: Modal displays colored status badges (yellow=pending_review, red=rejected, green=active).
CORRECT: Rejection comment box (testID=rejection-comment-box) shown for rejected products with admin_comment or 'Aucun motif fourni' when no comment.
CORRECT: Edit button label changes: 'Corriger et resoumettre' for rejected, 'Modifier l'annonce' for others.
CORRECT: Edit mode stepper loads pre-filled data: title, price (8), quantity (1), condition 'Bon' all pre-populated via apiToFormData().
CORRECT: Deep link product_rejected in push-notifications.ts routes to /products/create?productId={id}&mode=edit.
CORRECT: GET /products/mine returns admin_comment and rejection_reason fields (verified 21 backend tests).
CORRECT: GET /products/{id}/detail returns lat, lng, return_rules and all edit fields needed for apiToFormData().
CORRECT: Rejected products show red border (cardRejected style with borderColor: '#EF444455').
NOTE: 'Suivant' button in stepper has purple background (#8B5CF6) - this is existing behavior from the stepper itself, not in scope of this fix.
seed_data_creation: Produit créé et supprimé pendant test: TEST_Product for deletion iter92 (supprimé via test_delete_product_flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 bugs fixed and verified. (1) Blue color #3B82F6 confirmed in my-products (Ajouter btn, header icon bg, price texts). (2) Product cards clickable - 15 found with testID product-card-{id}, modal opens on click. (3) Modal shows rejection comment box with admin_comment (or 'Aucun motif fourni'). (4) Edit button navigates to stepper in edit mode with pre-filled data (title, price, category, condition). (5) Deep link product_rejected → /products/create?productId={id}&mode=edit verified in push-notifications.ts. (6) Backend: GET /products/mine returns admin_comment+rejection_reason, GET /products/{id}/detail returns lat/lng/return_rules/all edit fields.

rca_of_the_issue.bug1_color: my-products.tsx was using purple #8B5CF6 — now uses BLUE const = '#3B82F6' for all blue UI elements.
rca_of_the_issue.bug2_deep_link: push-notifications.ts case 'product_rejected' now routes to /products/create?productId={id}&mode=edit instead of /products/my-products.
rca_of_the_issue.bug3_clickable: Product cards were not wrapped in TouchableOpacity — now each card has onPress={() => setSelected(p)} to open ProductDetailModal.
